title: Web console credentialed sign-in control
spec: The web console has no visible sign-in: the session is implicit, so multi-user setups cannot switch identity from the UI. Add a credentialed sign-in control to the console top bar: a login affordance that collects credentials, calls the session API through the shared API client, reflects the signed-in identity, and supports sign-out. Wire it into the top bar without disturbing the existing layout.
